description: This file contains top-level functions for generating various ISCC (International Standard Content Code) codes for files, including content, metadata, data, and instance hashes. It handles different media types such as text, image, audio, and video, and supports advanced features like semantic coding and container processing. The functions facilitate creating comprehensive identifiers for digital assets, integrating metadata extraction, media analysis, and code generation.

methods.name: code_iscc
methods.description: Generates a complete ISCC-CODE for a given file, combining meta, content, data, and instance codes based on media type detection.

methods.name: code_meta
methods.description: Creates an ISCC Meta-Code based on extracted or provided metadata, normalizing and trimming fields.

methods.name: code_content
methods.description: Detects media type and routes to specific content code generation functions for text, image, audio, or video.

methods.name: code_text
methods.description: Generates a Text-Code from document files, optionally extracting metadata and creating thumbnails.

methods.name: code_text_semantic
methods.description: Creates a semantic Text-Code if the semantic package is installed.

methods.name: code_image
methods.description: Generates an Image-Code from image files, normalizing images and creating thumbnails.

methods.name: code_image_semantic
methods.description: Creates a semantic Image-Code if the semantic package is installed.

methods.name: code_audio
methods.description: Creates an Audio-Code from audio files, extracting acoustic fingerprints.

methods.name: code_video
methods.description: Creates a Video-Code from video files, extracting visual features and scene signatures.

methods.name: code_data
methods.description: Creates a similarity-preserving Data-Code hash of the raw input data.

methods.name: code_instance
methods.description: Creates a cryptographic hash (blake3) of the input data for integrity verification.

methods.name: code_sum
methods.description: Creates an ISCC code combining Data and Instance codes, processing file data once.

methods.name: code_iscc_mt
methods.description: Generates a complete ISCC-CODE with multithreaded processing, detecting media type and generating relevant codes.
